goal: Promptly destroy disconnected callbacks instead of leaking them until future signal connections
Prevent shutdown deadlocks when callbacks hold resources with destructor side effects
agreement: Asked whether this can slip the next major release since there is no rush (maflcko)

categories.name: utils
why: P2 because it prevents shutdown deadlocks from deferred callback destruction
Ensures resources like event loops in multiprocess mode are released promptly on disconnect
